textureEncoding: UASTC quality 2 / lossless Zstd 18 with full mip chains and retained JPEG fallback. Geometry and UV bytes unchanged.
placementContract: One merged LOD0 and one LOD1, one atlas material, _JUNGLE_AO indirect-only scalar and _WIND_FLEX rooted mask. Contact grids and profiles are measured from actual generated surfaces. Bottom anchored; fronts +Z.

customAttributes._JUNGLE_AO: Scalar0.8–1.0 from5hemisphere rays, indirect light only; radius0.14largest span/offset0.0018span.
customAttributes._WIND_FLEX: UVcolor/height rooted leaves; red leaf accents included; cloth rear edge/corners anchored with free front hem.

review: Each generated source was reviewed from front and rear in Blender; review renders remain in ignored .img2threejs/treehouse-trials-v2.
